answer: A new name is admitted only after a hanging-pendulum survey. The applicant stakes 36 coins and clamps a clerk-serialized 2.4 m invar rod to a bolted ledge bracket whose rust stamp is already on-ledger. For 11 minutes the rod swings while a camera at the published summit hut and a pressure pad on the mid-cliff terrace log its period. Peers require that period within 0.04 s of the local-g table and the same serial visible in both records. A studio mock or borrowed bracket misses the delay and the stamp, the stake burns, and one cliff cannot underwrite a crowd of aliases.
